reason: Complete the already-locked 1000+1000-pair actor holdout without changing either actor or waiting for one eight-core host to execute both blocks serially.

execution.compiler: gcc on the pinned ubuntu-24.04 build runner
execution.single_build_artifact: One arena binary and generated champion are built once, hashed, uploaded, then downloaded unchanged by every evaluation shard.
required_provenance: seed, pair range, rounds, and thread count

isolation_and_validation: The local 100+100-pair interim look remains an interim look only and is not pooled into the distributed final estimate.
All 1000+1000 final pairs are rerun from pair index zero with the single portable evaluator artifact.
Shards retain exact integer per-pair rows and a complete footer; merge rejects gaps, overlaps, metadata drift, provenance drift, malformed rows, and cap-terminated rounds.
Reciprocal blocks are merged separately, the baseline-first result is inverted, and the two block means are equal weighted with SE sqrt(SE1^2+SE2^2)/2.
The generic merger's displayed 1.645-SE field is descriptive only; the parent plan's final z>1.695 gate is authoritative.
No efficacy result may be inspected until all shards in both orientations complete and the merge succeeds.
Any runner-image, compiler, binary, model, source, actor, seed, range, or cap mismatch invalidates the final panel rather than being repaired post hoc.
